| check | status | failure class | detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| image-pinned | passed |  | rfl-ns3:m6 in ns3sim1 is sha256:da7a3245b1b91dd472d1ddb9497b3bd1abb3efdbaee38c45fe790dff565a61c6, the ns3.image pin |
| container-locked-down | passed |  | ns3sim1 is a kvm guest on kernel 6.8.0-147-generic; both containers ran the locked image as 10001:10001 with no network, no device, no capabilities, no-new-privileges, a read-only root, AppArmor docker-default and one writable mount /run/rfl/out; the entry point reported uid and gid 10001 |
| config-applied | passed |  | links.tsv and resolved.tsv hold every declared rate, delay, MTU 1000 B, CcMode 1, QbbEnabled true, EcnEnabled true, ECN thresholds in bytes, buffer, seed 1 and the ten DCQCN attributes; each sender put payload + 52 B per data packet on the wire and got 60 B ACKs |
| flow-completes | passed |  | all 1 flow(s) completed: the QpComplete trace fired and the receiver holds every byte in order; the simulator stopped at 88092 ns after the last completion |
| fct-lower-bound | passed |  | flow 0 FCT 88092 ns is 6092.0 ns (7.43%) above the bound 82000.0 ns = 80000.0 ns payload serialization + 2000 ns propagation. The model's mechanics give 88092 ns: 4000 ns for 52 B of headers per packet and integer-ns transmit times, 84 ns to forward the last packet after it fully arrived at the switch, 2008 ns for the 60 B ACK to return. Unexplained: 0 ns |
| zero-drops | passed |  | no drop anywhere: data packets lost on links 0, data packets the switch received and did not send 0, PhyRxDrop events 0, QbbDrop events 0, MMU drop lines on stdout 0, NACKs sent 0, data packets sent beyond one per segment 0 |
| no-pfc-pause | passed |  | QbbEnabled reads true on every port and the model recorded no pause: PFC frames sent 0, PAUSE received (QbbPfc 1) 0, RESUME received (QbbPfc 0) 0 |
| no-ecn-mark | passed |  | the switch's EcnEnabled reads true and the model marked nothing: CE-marked data packets the switch sent 0, CE-marked data packets hosts received 0, ACKs with the CNP flag hosts received 0, CNP packets sent 0, CNPs RdmaHw counted per QP 0 |
| rerun-identical | passed |  | the two runs gave the same 14 modeled figure files: cnp.tsv, counters.tsv, ecn-bands.tsv, events.tsv, flow-packets.tsv, flows.tsv, links.tsv, marks.tsv, pfc.tsv, queue-peaks.tsv, queues.tsv, rates.tsv, resolved.tsv, run.tsv |
| no-container-left | passed |  | guest.sh stop removed the containers of 20261116T151213Z-c-02-single-flow; no Track C container remains |
| host-untouched | passed |  | no simulator process and no Track C container on the host at the start and the end of the run |
